title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas 2 (Microsoft Xbox 360, 2008) Tested - See Pics
descriptionText:
See pics.

Experience the thrill of rainbow six with this Xbox 360 game. Take on the role of a highly trained operative in a team of elite agents as you try to complete challenging missions. With a rating of M for mature, this shooter game is not for the faint of heart. 

This game comes with a manual and features multiplayer mode, allowing you to compete against other players. Released in 2008 by Ubisoft, Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas 2 is part of the popular Rainbow Six series. Get ready to engage in intense firefights and tactical battles to complete your missions.
